title: HTTP request smuggling: proxy/back-end framing disagreement
index_line: T-0012 · AUTH_DECISION · CL.TE/TE.CL/H2 downgrade · timing oracle first · corroborated
invariant_violated: The front-end and back-end disagree about where this request ends; the smuggled prefix becomes the start of the next request.

mechanism.does: attacker sends a request with ambiguous framing (dual CL+TE, obfuscated TE, H2 with lying CL)
front-end picks one framing interpretation and forwards the bytes
bypass: the back-end honours the other header — TE obfuscation (xchunked, space-before-colon, duplicate-with-invalid, identity, case) or H2 downgrade
back-end treats the smuggled suffix as the start of the next request
impact: next user's request answered by attacker-chosen routing — auth bypass, credential capture, cache poisoning

source.http.request.value: the smuggled second request (GET /admin, partial request for the next user to complete)

proxy.desync.value: the CL/TE pair disagreement — CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE, H2.CL

encoding.http-framing.value: dual CL+TE · Transfer-Encoding:xchunked · 'Transfer-Encoding : chunked' (space) · \x0b variant · duplicate-with-second-invalid · identity · H2 frame with CL

guard.pipeline.value: proxy normalization + patch state — dual-header rejection is the healthy (resisting) behaviour

oracle.timing.value: response-time stall on the CL.TE probe — the safe first step

preconditions.expr: HTTP/1.1 keep-alive path through a proxy pair (or H2 front-end downgrading to H1)
front-end/back-end split exists (single-server deployments are not smuggleable)
attacker-controlled bytes on a keep-alive connection reach the pair
none — framing confusion needs no authentication

success: timing stall on the CL.TE probe (back-end waits for a chunk that never comes)
next legitimate request answered with the smuggled GET's response (known-404 echo)
another user's request body/headers appended to the smuggled partial request (credential capture)
failure_like: pair rejects dual CL+TE (patched — good sign)
both layers agree on framing — no desync
false_positive: timing noise from network jitter (repeat the probe before claiming a stall)
response splitting without a proxy pair — different bug class

hazards: the vulnerability lives in the proxy/backend PAIR, not a language — fingerprints: old HAProxy, nginx 1.x, Apache Traffic Server, custom proxies
keep-alive mandatory; curl normalizes headers — raw sockets required
H2 smuggling needs the proxy to downgrade to HTTP/1.1 for the back-end
non_transfers: major CDNs for the classic vectors (patched — focus custom stacks)
